fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Stable unit key. Primary key.

fields.name: unit_name
fields.description: Unit name only.

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Nationality: the `name` of a row of data/nationalities.csv (foreign key). The lowercase value is the folder under data/claims/.

fields.name: echelon
fields.description: Organisational level (see vocabulary).

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Service or arm (see vocabulary).

fields.name: theater
fields.description: Primary theater of the unit (single value; claim rows carry their own theater).

fields.name: parent_unit_id
fields.description: Fixed organic parent unit, used for battle groups and combat commands (their parent division). Blank for units whose parent changes with time; use claims.parent_unit_id and the command relations (data/command_relations.csv) for time-dependent parents.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: How much of the unit has been researched: placeholder (identity only, no claim file), partial (claim file exists but coverage is known to be incomplete) or active (claim file exists). A placeholder is not a claim about where the unit was. Exactly the placeholders have no claim file (the validator checks this).

fields.name: formed_date
fields.description: Formation or activation date of the unit (or of the designation the record uses, see unit_note) as given by formed_date_source: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY. Blank if not known. It is not the date the unit arrived in the theater.

fields.name: formed_date_source
fields.description: URL of the page that gives formed_date. Required when formed_date is set.

fields.name: initial_parent_unit_id
fields.description: Placeholder-level hint: the formation this unit is listed under in the source named by initial_parent_source, as of initial_parent_as_of. Blank where no source clearly gives it. Not an organic-versus-attached statement and not a claim; use claims.parent_unit_id and the command relations (data/command_relations.csv) for that. Distinct from parent_unit_id (fixed organic parent of battle groups).

fields.name: initial_parent_as_of
fields.description: Date the listing in initial_parent_source applies to (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Required when initial_parent_unit_id is set.

fields.name: initial_parent_source
fields.description: Source token (see vocabulary source_token) for initial_parent_unit_id. Required when initial_parent_unit_id is set.

fields.name: component_of_note
fields.description: Free-text note on the placeholder parent link, for example why it is left blank or that the source lists the unit under two formations.

fields.name: unit_note
fields.description: Free-text note on the unit's identity: renames, reconstitutions, lineage caveats or uncertain Western Front service.

fields.name: listing_source
fields.description: Semicolon-separated source tokens (vocabulary source_token) naming where the unit was found when the placeholder was created. A listing is not evidence of any date or place.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Domain of the unit: ground, air or naval. Required; blank is not allowed (Task 4, RP3, 24 November 2026). Every domain is written to the unified build/ outputs, with this column present so users can filter. The who_controls grid still defaults to in-scope ground units.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Scope marker (vocabulary scope): in_scope or out_of_scope; blank means in_scope in the master file, and build/units.csv writes in_scope explicitly. A unit marked out_of_scope is recorded, with its claims and command relations, in the unified build/ files; the who_controls grid still defaults to in-scope ground (standing rule 22, Scott, 13 November 2026; Task 4, 24 November 2026).

fields.name: ship_type
fields.description: Ship type of a unit with echelon naval_unit (vocabulary ship_type: US hull codes BB, BC, BM, CV, CVL, CVE, CA, CL, DD, DE, PF, CORV, TB, PG, CM, AM, SS). Blank for every other echelon. When ship_class_id is set it must equal the ship_type of that class.

fields.name: hull_number
fields.description: Hull number, pennant, pendant or hull marking exactly as the source gives it (BB-35, L26, S-36, U-47, HMS D 16). Free text and not a key: pennants were reused and numbers were reassigned. Blank for every echelon except naval_unit, and blank where no source gives one.

fields.name: ship_class_id
fields.description: Class id (SC###, data/ship_classes.csv) of the ship's class or sub-type. Blank when no class is recorded. The class must exist and its ship_type must equal the unit's ship_type. Only on a unit with echelon naval_unit.
